hints: Insertion is a BFS: pop nodes in level order; the first one with a NULL left gets the new node there, else the first with a NULL right. Check left before right for every node.
Keep the records in the tree nodes themselves: a struct with vno, model, price, left and right. Read the model with %s - models have no spaces.
search must look in both subtrees (not a BST). Print -1 when not found.
